reviews.review_text:

Then customer service said I had to spend ( X ) amount more to recieve that promotion.  I open the app and IMMEDIATELY i'm attacked by the these spinning wheels & IRRITATING FAST PACED POP- UPS saying I won. 
I rejected the offers and EVENTUALLY made it back to the shopping page. I bought 2 more items & spent another $41.00 and I STILL HAVEN'T RECIEVED MY $100.00 VOUCHER NOR DID I GET ANY OF THE FREE OR DISCOUNTED ITEMS THAT I WAS SUPPOSED TO GET. I was given a $10 store credit that I haven't used yet. Make A long story short--- THERE ARE NO FREE ITEMS OR BIG SAVINGS ON TEMU. ITS  A SCAM. THERE IS NO WAY OF STICKING WITH ONE PROMOTION.
THEY DO THIS PURPOSELY. IN THE END I PAYED THE SAME AMOUNT IF MONEY I WOULD HAVE PURCHASING THE ITEMS ON AMAZON -- ALSO WITH AMAZON I WOULD HAVE RECIEVED MY ORDERS WITHIN 48 HOURS  INSTEAD OF BEING FORCED TO WAIT A WEEK AND A HALF.

reviews.review_title: IVE HAD ENOUGH OF AN APPAULING EXPERIENCES & SERVICES!
reviews.review_text:
What went wrong!  I had an issue with an InPost delivery driver, he decided he 'Couldn't find my adress!'  The company made all the usual excuses, as per their, lets just palm the customer off with the same sickly, dire-tribe like, Temu's Customer Services tries on its customers!!  So I asked if he can't find my adress, the courier [FROM INPOST] he/she has a mobile phone there is a free Sat-Nav available on Google or Waze, its simple as that!!  You use your intelligence!  
So now my expected delivery, which we waited in for was taken back to the depot!! [BECAUSE THE INPIST COURIER COULD NOT FIND MY ADRESS!] I have to wait until...'They  [InPost] find an alternative courier to deliver the parcel.
I, AS THE CUSTOMER SHOULD NOT BE CONTACTING THE COURIER! THAT IS WHY TEMU HAS CUSTOMER SERVICES!  THEY SHOULD BE DOING THIS, BUT THEY DON'T! THEY DO TELL LIES & HALF TRUTHS & MISLEAD THE CUSTOMER INTO BELIEVING THEY HAVE JUST MOVED MOUNT EVEREST, WHEN IN AFFECT THEY HAVE DONE NOTHING EXCEPT EMPTY, PLATITUDES!!
Instead they promise you they are doing this, that & the other for you, when they are clearly not doing anything at all!   
They AVOID answering your questions, they DEFLECT you with automated responses which only requires them to use one finger to press an on screen button!!  Then they are either dealing with other customers simultaneously or ignoring you & chatting with nearby colleages as there are extremely long pauses! And I mean extremely long indeed!!  Then they press that 'automated text button again!'  This is the lowest form of CS I have ever experienced, I will go as far as stating categorically... THIS IS NOT CUSTOMER SERVICE AT ALL.'
They are deliberately geared TO NOT HELP YOU IN THE LEAST, THEY MIGHT AS WELL BE NON-EXISTANT!! But to cause you as much irritation as possible in order for you to give-up with them and go away, makes their life easy!  
I requested they block InPost for the very reason's I have explained above!!  
PLUS INPOST also has a terrible, ineffectual CS too! And those guys are RUDE & OBTUSE beyond belief!! 
I repeatedly requested Temu's CS rep. to block InPost from my account.  The rep.  ignored my requests completely.
Ive just had enough of Temu's appauling way in which they treat their customer's.. Plus refusing to BLOCK InPost from delivering any of my parcels!!
So enough is enough!! 
I have pram that was due for delivery on Monday its now Tuesday, InPost are still stating that 'they are looking for an available courier to deliver the parcel!!  What a joke.  You order off Temu from a Local seller that provides next day delivery and inpost is not only letting those sellars down that provide that quick local service but us customers too!  That is why we use 'Local' sellers to get goods faster than shipping direct from China!  But because of InPost's lack of available, literate, couriers then we the customer are not getting the service of next day or the two-day delivery window.
InPost should not be given any business at all with any reputable company as they are swamped and unable to meet the hugh demands of a modern delivery service!!   
So just up the road from where I live is a InPost delivery & sorting centre & my pram instead of being delivered is languashing there until they can find someone to deliver it!!  Wowww! The very company the BBC caned!! & they state they are a fantastic delivery company, well they are not!!
My husband said he will drive me there to the InPost centre to collect my parcel (pram)  in person!!  
So now AFTER REPEATED REQUESTS, TEMU REFUSES TO BLOCK INPOST FROM MY ACCOUNT & STOP THEM DELIVERING MY PARCELS, So my only other viable  option left open to me is to vote with my feet, walk-away from Temu,  stop shopping with them altogether!
I have about 4 deliveries outstanding (due), thankfully only one is with that awful InPost and then I am closing my account with Temu!

I will no longer put up with a rude, ineffectual company that has no regard for its customer's! their Customer Services,  constant lying as they  don't care about their customer's in the least, rather they want our cash but provide no experience when it comes to accountability towards customers.
So Temu enjoy your relationship with that diabolical, ineffectual InPost.. I am finished with your company once the last of my orders come through!
If anyone wants to know more about InPost then the BBC has done a really transarent article of just how bad they are, plus on-line complaints on Redit & FB & Vinted amongst just three of many complaints such as mine.  
I refuse to deal or accept such a diabolucal, non- existant CS such as Temu who refuses to take accountability towards its customers in a transparent  honest way..  Ohh, but they take our money quick enough.. but not any longer.
GOOD BYE, TO NON-EXISTANT CUSTOMER SERVICES  & GOOD BYE, TO INPOST TOO!!
BUYER  BE WARNED!!

reviews.review_title: If I could give zero stars I would!!
reviews.review_text:
If I could give zero stars I would!!! Let us begin with clothing. What you receive is hardly what is displayed on their site. The fabric is inferior. The flow of the garment is misleading. The fit is often off, particularly with regards to length. They are either entirely too short and or is not as full or flowing as is depicted in the photo. 
Other items such as jewelry. Earrings are much smaller than shown in pictures. So misleading. Art… much smaller and shorter than what is photographed. I purchased images which were displayed behind a sofa seemingly filled the wall just as you would have it. They appeared to be 24 maybe 30 inches in the picture. Upon arrival they were 10 to 12 inches. If you place them behind the sofa on the wall, you would never see them!!!
Your order seldom arrive together returning them is a nightmare. Their Bogus credit plan where you earn points to be applied to your purchase. Makes no sense at all. I ordered from them 02 years ago so disappointed. After two years I stumbled upon the site again saw a couple items that were appealing and just as it was two years ago, junk!!! I would dare say save your money. Shame on Temu and shame on the powers that be that allow them to get away with this. Misrepresentation of products, keeping inferior fabrics products, and not resembling photos.

reviews.review_title: Bad practice by Temu
reviews.review_text:
I have been a  very good customer of Temu, never had a problem that wasn’t sorted straight away. However my last experience has left a sour taste.
I ordered a ladies Jacket size 16 and some pegs to make up minimum order. Jacket arrived  a very small parcel. Very badly creased and sleeves were very wide and long.
Asked for return. Was offered 84p + £11, as I thought, credit. Turned out it was a coupon and only 3 days shelf life! I made my order up to £15, and kept getting message, had to add more for free delivery over £15. Ended up £26 and I decided, I wasn’t happy about the situation at all. So I have  cancelled the whole order. 
Normally you would get a credit, never heard of Coupon which expires in 3 days.
So Temu, I shall give the jacket to Charity and I have lost my just on £12. But you have lost a ver valued customer, 
I am extremely disappointed with the situation . 

Update, Temu sent message on  Trustpilot after my review. Said they would look into it. Advised me to contact Customer Service Bot. Did this got no joy. Was supposed then to pass me on to agent. After trying to explain through messages the problem I was told to give order number. It meant coming off the chat and getting the Order number. Told them this. After 30 minutes I’ve given up. My time is not being wasted on Temu any more. Terrible company when things go wrong.

Still waiting for Temu to contact me. Have sent order number, email etc. They are all talk. Nobody has contacted me. Just beware of their stupid offers. They don’t exist. Extremely dissatisfied by Temu. Be warned!

reviews.review_title: I have given this a 2 star review…
reviews.review_text:
I have given this a 2 star review because I have not been unhappy with Temu's service until recently. I was dubious initially about shopping from Temu as had heard that they sell customers data to 3rd parties, still not had evidence of this in the 2 years I have been shopping with them, but my recent experience has now made me decide not to continue giving them my custom.  A package I ordered was delivered to someone elses property by the courier. I asked for a refund, but was denied it twice. Temu and the seller consistently said the package had been delivered. This disagreement between us has now lasted over a week and in that time, I have pointed out to Temu and the seller that the pinpointed GPS location from the couriers scanner does not match the location of my property. I have yet to see if they accept this as they have refused to accept all previous denials that the package has been delivered to my property. So I will not give Temu my custom again. 
And this is what I have just read on another customers review - if your items do not arrive, arrive damaged, or do not match the description or photos, you will be offered a full refund under Temu's Purchase Protection program - they have twice refused to refund me for an undelivered parcel but expect me to go round to neighbours houses asking if they have it.
